# rea-captcha

> Local-first verification challenge handling for browser agents. Keep a Browser Use or Playwright task in its existing browser session, use an authorized test action or human handoff, require fresh validation evidence, and then resume the same task.

## Primary links

- Source and setup: https://github.com/masakaai/rea-captcha
- Controlled live cases: https://rea-captcha.vercel.app/
- npm package: https://www.npmjs.com/package/rea-captcha
- MCP Registry name: io.github.masakaai/rea-captcha
- MCP tool reference: https://github.com/masakaai/rea-captcha/blob/main/docs/mcp-tools.md
- Full agent-readable reference: https://rea-captcha.vercel.app/llms-full.txt

## Scope

rea-captcha supports official provider test keys, explicitly authorized owned origins, and bounded human handoff. It does not automate unknown third-party production CAPTCHA challenges, provide a hosted solver, transfer credentials, or make stealth claims.
